findings.evidence: `pkg/planner/core/logical_plan_builder.go` adds `appendAuxiliaryFieldsForSubqueries()` and calls it from `resolveWindowFunction()`; it runs `b.rewrite(ctx, expr, p, nil, true)` on extracted subquery-bearing expressions just to discover correlated outer columns, discarding the rewritten expr/plan. `b.rewrite()` can execute *uncorrelated* scalar/EXISTS subqueries during optimization via `EvalSubqueryFirstRow` (`pkg/planner/core/expression_rewriter.go`, which calls into `pkg/executor/select.go` where `EvalSubqueryFirstRow` builds and runs an executor).
findings.fix: Avoid executing subqueries in the auxiliary-field discovery pass. Minimal approach: temporarily set `b.disableSubQueryPreprocessing = true` only around the `b.rewrite()` call(s) inside `appendAuxiliaryFieldsForSubqueries`, restoring it afterward, so discovery never triggers `EvalSubqueryFirstRow`. Alternative: plumb a dedicated “no-execution / correlated-cols-only” rewrite mode, or cache/reuse the later rewrite result so the subquery is rewritten at most once.
findings.impact: Queries with window expressions/specs that contain uncorrelated scalar or EXISTS subqueries can have those subqueries executed an extra time during planning (once in the new discovery pass, again during the real window arg/spec rewrite). This can cause user-visible side effects (e.g., sequence `nextval()`, locks, user-variable mutations), change nondeterministic results, and add extra executor work during optimization.
findings.verify: Add a regression test with a side-effectful uncorrelated scalar/EXISTS subquery inside a window expression/spec (e.g., using a sequence `nextval(seq)`), and assert the side effect happens exactly once. Also re-run the existing window subquery tests to ensure correlated outer-ref preservation still works.
findings.what: New window-subquery auxiliary-field discovery rewrites subquery expressions in a way that can execute uncorrelated scalar/EXISTS subqueries during planning, potentially causing double execution/side effects and semantic changes.

subject: planner: preserve outer refs in window subqueries (#66869)
summary: Planner change correctly broadens subquery-kind handling inside window expressions/specs and preserves outer refs, but the auxiliary-field discovery pass rewrites subqueries via `b.rewrite()` in a way that can execute uncorrelated scalar/EXISTS subqueries during optimization, risking double execution/side effects; no later upstream fix found.
